name: manual_c7eb86
claim: OpenClaw env.shellEnv imports only missing well-known provider keys, so a custom key such as the W&B one never reaches the gateway; put such keys in the trusted global env file under the OpenClaw state folder and restart the gateway, because it is read only at startup.

decisions.notes: Observed 2026-11-26: W&B calls failed with secret-reference-not-found until the global env file held the key and the gateway restarted; a forced W&B run then returned in about five seconds.

rationale: Observed 2026-11-26: W&B calls failed with secret-reference-not-found until the global env file held the key and the gateway restarted; a forced W&B run then returned in about five seconds.
